persona: MIS analyst at a finance company who already runs data checks, moving into data governance
resumeText:
Pooja Iyer | Mumbai | pooja.iyer@example.com

- Build Power BI dashboards for branch-wise collection MIS.

SKILLS
SQL, Excel, Power BI, Collibra
